title: Lead the progress page with the walking controller's 26-case result
summary: The latest-progress block still showed the 12 October probe result. It now reports c48_long, the walking controller accepted on 7 November, judged on the 26 stage2_flat cases in the CPU surrogate: judgement.json records 14 failed cases of 26, so 12 pass, including all five routes, which stop 58 to 64 mm from the last goal. Every failed case exceeds the 0.1 m drift limit, and two also exceed the 1.7 degree stop tilt by 0.05 and 0.11 degrees. The 8 November update record says three cases pass everything; that count predates the stand-and-stop tilt rule, and the judgement file rewritten under that rule (d846c3a2) gives 12. The progress check now counts a named list for the headline value as it already did for the total, so the number reads straight from the judgement's failed_cases list; a numeric field still reads as before. The page adds the term Drift and one accomplishment line, within the 650-word page limit. The videos are unchanged and the text says they show an earlier controller.
